run_train: run the train function to start impact-driven exploration training with intrinsic rewards on MiniGrid or Doom environments
run_learn: run the learn function to perform a single optimization step computing forward and inverse dynamics losses
review_learn: review the learn function to understand how intrinsic rewards are computed from state embedding differences
review_train: review the train function to understand the multi-actor multi-learner training loop with vtrace returns
refactor_learn: refactor the learn function to support additional dynamics loss types beyond forward and inverse models
